text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was walking around the 
academy...
(Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aah!! I'm so sorry! Are you alright?!

Upon bumping into me, Kitasan Black 
dropped her things, scattering the 
contents all over the floor. When I picked 
them up—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, is this cold medicine something 
you dropped as well~?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
And over here are energy drinks... 
Kita-chan, are you feeling sick?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not me, it's Dia-chan. I was just 
on my way to nurse her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan has a race coming up soon too... 
All I can really do is bring her care 
packages, but I just couldn't sit still.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
That's our Kita-chan...! In that case, 
sports drinks are great too! Here, take 
this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please take some apple compote too. I was 
just thinking about giving you some, you 
see~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I stewed the apples you helped me carry 
from the shopping district the other day~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, from back then! Dia-chan will be so 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, take this with ya too! It's a token of 
gratitude from the great Golshi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Kita-chan! I brought what 
you were looking for earlier~☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So much stuff... Are you all really okay 
with this?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is always helping us out, so we 
wanted to pay you back at a time like 
this!
choice_data_list: It'll be tough alone, I'll help carry them

It'll be tough carrying all that alone, 
let me help

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And... we're here. Dia-chan, are you 
awake? How are you feeling?
choice_data_list: I'll set the get-well gifts down here

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...? You came—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright? Are you cold? I bought 
cold medicine, the kind you always take!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gave us so much delicious food, 
so eat up, take your medicine, and rest, 
okay? Deal!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Kita-chan, I'm sorry... Making you 
prepare so much... and making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about! I'm doing this 
completely on my own!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look, our race is coming up soon, right? 
This time, I want to front-run and stay 
ahead of you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat you, Dia-chan! But it won't 
count unless you're in tip-top shape!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
See? It's my own selfish wish too! So 
don't worry about it, just leave 
everything to me!
choice_data_list: You'll have to get well soon, then
Can't let yourself lose to that energy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
See? It's my own selfish wish too! So 
don't worry about it, just leave 
everything to me!
choice_data_list: You'll have to get well soon, then
You'll have to get well soon, then, huh
Can't let yourself lose to that energy!

Can't let yourself lose to that energy, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to run at full power with 
you again... no, as many times as it 
takes, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
After everything you've done for me... I 
promise I'll be in perfect shape for the 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nnngh, yeah!!

In the twilight infirmary, the two shared 
a warm, close moment together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! In terms of energy, I can't afford 
to lose to you either, Kita-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat plenty, sleep well... and get way 
more energized than I was before catching 
this cold...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Alright then... Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for full recovery, Satono Diamond 
has entered the gate!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, apple compote, carrot porridge... 
and cold medicine. Preparations are 
complete...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Can she overtake Kitasan Black in pure 
"cheerfulness"? The highly anticipated 
race is about to begin!

The girls' laughter and delicious aromas 
filled the twilight infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I'll eat plenty and get all 
better—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What is that bottle? "Golshi's Pit 
Viper"...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Ah, that's the mysterious drink Gold 
Ship-san handed to me...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Potent Antibiotic Umacillin"? Wow, there 
are so many things here I've never seen 
before—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wah wah! Stooop! Wait, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with the milder stuff first, 
pleeease?!
